versions.changelog:
- Initial release of growth-email skill focused on SaaS onboarding sequences
- Provides rules for effective onboarding emails: instant welcome, behavior-triggered, personal voice, single goal per email, and A/B subject line testing
- Includes a quick reference table for common SaaS onboarding email types, triggers, and goals
- Lists common mistakes to avoid when building onboarding sequences
- Guidance to validate onboarding improvements with AI user testing via Racoonn
